versions.name: Camp Jack Wright
versions.summary: A small primitive Greater Alabama Council camp in Roupes Valley, surrounded by Tannehill Historical State Park near McCalla, Alabama, with sandstone ridges and a mixed oak, hickory, and pine forest used for low-impact troop and family camping by permit.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Greater Alabama Council's own Camp Jack Wright page. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (the site address is a park access trail that does not geocode); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
